name: Transaction Management Workflow
tasks: Create transaction object;Build deadline timeline;Run QA Gate 1;Monitor deadlines;Run pre-closing QA;Archive final file;Trigger Customer Success
decision_points: Is the file complete?;Is any deadline at risk?;Is closing ready?
exceptions: Missing document;Missed deadline;Closing delay;Commission confirmation missing
completion_criteria: Transaction closed, final QA complete, file archived, Customer Success handoff created.

name: Contract Drafting Workflow
tasks: Collect terms;Confirm form type;Prepare draft;Review draft;Send for approval;Track revisions;Archive final version
decision_points: Are required terms complete?;Is client approval received?;Is legal interpretation being requested?
exceptions: Missing required terms;Conflicting instructions;Urgent same-day draft;Legal interpretation requested
completion_criteria: Final approved document archived with version history.

name: Licensed Showing Coverage Workflow
tasks: Confirm property details;Verify access instructions;Assign provider;Confirm appointment;Complete showing;Send feedback;Close request
decision_points: Are access instructions complete?;Is a licensed provider available?;Are there safety concerns?
exceptions: Missing access instructions;No provider available;Same-day request;Safety concern
completion_criteria: Showing completed, feedback sent, request closed.

name: Customer Success Handoff Workflow
stages: Closing Complete;Thank You;Satisfaction Check;Review Request;Referral Opportunity;Relationship Nurture
tasks: Send thank-you;Check satisfaction;Request review;Identify referral opportunity;Schedule nurture touchpoint
decision_points: Was the experience positive?;Is client likely to refer?;Should testimonial be requested?
completion_criteria: Review/referral path completed or nurture cadence scheduled.
